name: Mándok (Hungary)
description: Pale blue field charged at the centre with the town arms of Mándok: a quartered blue, white and green shield with a sword, bars, an apple, a bunch of grapes and a ploughshare, bordered in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
